environment.description: Same application deployed identically but with AWS WAFv2 WebACL associated to the ALB. The WebACL contains a single rule group reference: a custom rule group (priority 1, action=BLOCK) with two rules operating in sequence. Rule 1: SizeConstraint on QueryString with ComparisonOperator GT and Size 128 bytes (action=BLOCK). Rule 2: RegexPatternSet match on UriPath=/api/users/search with a SqliMatchStatement inspecting SingleQueryArgument 'value' with TextTransformation URL_DECODE followed by TextTransformation COMPRESS_WHITE_SPACE, sensitivity level HIGH, action=BLOCK. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm both rules are actively evaluating (SampledRequests > 0 in last 24h).

config.alb: internet-facing, HTTPS:443 -> HTTP:8080, WAFv2 WebACL associated
config.instance: t3.medium, Amazon Linux 2, same security group
